# Larpinq

> Larpinq is a Nextcloud app for LARP (live-action role-play) organisations: worlds, characters, players, game mechanics with a stat-calculation engine, events with registrations and XP awards, and printable character sheets, with its data stored in OpenRegister.

## Start here

- [README](README.md): what the app does, installation, Docker evaluation stack and tech stack
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): setup, build, test, lint and the OpenSpec flow for coding agents
- [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md): branching model, pull requests and commit message conventions

## Documentation

- [Introduction](docs/intro.md): getting started with Larpinq
- [Architecture](docs/architecture.md): schema-driven design, every object stored in OpenRegister
- [Features](docs/FEATURES.md): feature overview
- [Feature pages](docs/features/README.md): one page per feature area
- [Run a local demo](docs/Installation/demo-environment.md): a working Larpinq on your own machine
- [Directory structure](docs/directories.md): what each folder is for
- [Style guide](docs/styleguide.md): frontend styling decisions

## API

- [OpenAPI document](openapi.json): the JSON API of Larpinq (character sheets and builds, events, registrations, check-in, XP awards, worlds, setup)
- [API contract spec](openspec/specs/api-contract/spec.md): versioned paths, problem-details errors and how the OpenAPI document is published
- [Register definition](lib/Settings/larpinq_register.json): the OpenRegister schemas for the app's data types, extended by the fragments in lib/Settings/register.d/

## Specs and decisions

- [OpenSpec config](openspec/config.yaml): project context and rules for specs
- [Character management spec](openspec/specs/character-management/spec.md): characters and the stat-calculation engine
- [Game mechanics spec](openspec/specs/game-mechanics/spec.md): abilities, skills, items, conditions and effects
- [Event registration spec](openspec/specs/event-registration/spec.md): sign-ups, registration status and capacity
- [Event XP awards spec](openspec/specs/event-xp-awards/spec.md): per-participant XP awards after an event
- [PDF export spec](openspec/specs/pdf-export/spec.md): character sheets and run-sheets rendered through DocuDesk
- [ADR-001 Integrate, don't build](openspec/architecture/adr-001-integrate-dont-build.md): consume OpenRegister abstractions and integration apps
- [ADR-002 GM authorization](openspec/architecture/adr-002-gm-authorization-single-group.md): one canonical game-master group
- [ADR-003 Lore pages](openspec/architecture/adr-003-lore-pages-are-register-objects.md): lore pages are register objects, not a wiki
